youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的「招待外客」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從門鈴響了兩次、請客人脫鞋換上軟拖鞋、帶她看客房與床上的兩條毛巾、在茶角泡一壺甘茶配鹹餅乾、教客人用筷子夾花生與豆腐丸、翻開家庭相簿介紹媽媽、艾米、小斌與艾瑪、一起玩四個人兩輪的桌遊 Island Trip、留客人把第五頓飯吃完，一直到星期一上午九點半把他們送上計程車。兩個人把數字講得清清楚楚：客人琳達從芝加哥來，芝加哥比我們晚十四個小時；星期五上午十點四十落地、在飛機上待十三小時、只睡兩個小時；在我們家住三晚；客用毛巾每天兩條、拖鞋兩雙、床上一大床兩個枕頭、椅子上多一條備用被子；前後一起吃了五頓飯，午餐是第一頓、週日晚餐是第五頓；桌遊 Island Trip 四個人玩、打完兩輪已經十點；星期一上午九點半計程車到門口、十一點報到櫃台關、十二點開始登機、落地時間接近他們的午餐時間。教你把「教她用筷子」和「介紹家人照片」變成兩個值得回頭重講的溫暖時刻。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Hosting Friends from Abroad phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — the doorbell rings twice, shoes come off at the step, two soft slippers wait by the door, the guest room is shown with two fresh towels and one extra quilt, tea is brewed in the corner, and the evening turns into chopsticks practice with peanuts and one stubborn tofu ball. Later the family album comes out, four people play two rounds of the board game Island Trip, dinner stays on the table, and Monday morning ends with a taxi at nine thirty. Every number matches: Linda flies in from Chicago, which runs fourteen hours behind; she landed at ten forty after thirteen hours in the air and slept only two hours; she stays three nights; two clean towels every day, two pairs of slippers, one big bed with two pillows; five shared meals in all, lunch being meal one of five and Sunday dinner the fifth; Island Trip for four players, two rounds done by ten o'clock; the taxi arrives at nine thirty on Monday, the counter closes at eleven, boarding starts at twelve, and she lands close to her own lunch time. Two moments come back again and again — teaching her the chopsticks, and showing the family photos. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!
char_a_description: the host, warm and practical (male voice)
char_b_description: Linda, the guest from Chicago (female voice)

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doorbell rang two times.
dialogue.zh: 門鈴響了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is us, we rang twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt ɪz ʌs, wi ræŋ twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，按鈴的是我們，我按了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, we missed the first ring.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，第一聲鈴響我們沒聽到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four years apart, and here we are.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr jɪrz əˈpɑrt, ænd hɪr wi ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 四年沒見，我們總算又站在你家門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is Doug, right?
dialogue.zh: 這位就是道格，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is, the one who rang.
dialogue.zh: 就是他，剛剛按鈴的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come in, take it slow now.
dialogue.zh: 快進來，慢慢走就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your front step is a little steep.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr frʌnt stɛp ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl stip./
dialogue.zh: 你家門口的台階有一點陡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you lift this heavy box?
dialogue.zh: 這個重箱子你撐得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me that, my back is strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ðæt, maɪ bæk ɪz strɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 給我吧，我的腰還有力量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave your shoes by the mat.
dialogue.zh: 鞋子放在地墊旁邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my socks are clean today.
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我今天襪子是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are two pairs of soft slippers.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr tu pɛrz ʌv sɔft ˈslɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩雙軟軟的拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine fit, thanks for thinking.
dialogue.zh: 我這雙大小剛好，謝謝你想這麼周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We never wear shoes on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈnɛvər wɛr ʃuz ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們在家都不穿鞋踩地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same at home, so this feels easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm æt hoʊm, soʊ ðɪs filz ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 我們家也是，這樣一點都不彆扭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we hang the coats?
dialogue.zh: 外套要掛在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That low hook holds two of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt loʊ hʊk hoʊldz tu ʌv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 那個矮一點的鉤子可以掛兩件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want some water right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt sʌm ˈwɔtər raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你現在想喝點水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water sounds great, the plane was dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər saʊndz ɡreɪt, ðə pleɪn wɑz draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 給我水吧，飛機上面好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down and take a load off.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn ænd teɪk ə loʊd ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，好好歇一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My feet asked for this bench.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳正想要這條長凳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the taxi ride smooth?
dialogue.zh: 計程車這一趟還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty minutes, and the driver talked.
dialogue.zh: 五十分鐘，而且司機一路都在聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You landed at ten forty, yes?
dialogue.zh: 你們是十點四十落地的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We walked out near eleven o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 我們差不多十一點才走出航廈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours on the plane, wow.
dialogue.zh: 在飛機上待了十三個小時，天啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept for two hours only.
dialogue.zh: 我只有睡兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chicago runs fourteen hours behind us.
dialogue.zh: 芝加哥的時間比我們晚十四個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So my body thinks it is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈbɑdi θɪŋks ɪt ɪz dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 所以我的身體以為現在是晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look fresh for that hour.
dialogue.zh: 那個時段落地還能這樣，已經很好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me one real night of sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi wʌn ril naɪt ʌv slip./
dialogue.zh: 請給我一晚真正的睡眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, say hello to our guests.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，跟客人打個招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hides behind your legs fast.
dialogue.zh: 他一下子就躲到你腿後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New people make him hide.
dialogue.zh: 他一見到生人就會躲起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids warm up by tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 小孩到了明天早上就熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mochi wants to meet you both.
dialogue.zh: 麻糬想見你們兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is she friendly, or does she bite?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ʃi ˈfrɛndli, ər dʌz ʃi baɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 她親人嗎？會不會咬人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She only licks, that is all.
dialogue.zh: 她只會用舌頭舔，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, Doug loves a gentle dog.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，道格最喜歡溫柔的小狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One case is missing a wheel.
dialogue.zh: 有一個箱子的輪子不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The airline did that, I am sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn dɪd ðæt, aɪ əm ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 肯定是航空公司弄壞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do their cases go?
dialogue.zh: 他們的行李要擱在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the wall, out of the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə wɔl, aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 靠牆放，別擋著走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your room is down this hall.
dialogue.zh: 你的房間在這條走廊的尾端。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stairs, my knees thank you.
dialogue.zh: 不用爬樓梯，我的膝蓋感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom wrote a list for today.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽為今天寫了一張清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is lunch still one hour away?
dialogue.zh: 還有一個小時才開飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour, and then we eat.
dialogue.zh: 再一小時，然後就吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me the towels first, please.
dialogue.zh: 請先帶我看毛巾擺在哪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fresh towels rest on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu frɛʃ ˈtaʊəlz rɛst ɑn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 兩條乾淨毛巾攤在床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You set all this out for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛt ɔl ðɪs aʊt fər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 這一切都是你替我們擺好的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We planned this visit for weeks.
dialogue.zh: 我們幾個星期前就開始安排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted the days all year.
dialogue.zh: 我整年都在數日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the rug slides a bit.
dialogue.zh: 小心，地毯會滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I held the table, I am fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɛld ðə ˈteɪbəl, aɪ əm faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我扶到桌子了，沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our home is small, but it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər hoʊm ɪz smɔl, bʌt ɪt wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 我們家小，不過很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small rooms hold more talking.
dialogue.zh: 房間小，話就特別多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the light switch.
dialogue.zh: 電燈開關在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too bright, may I use one lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu braɪt, meɪ aɪ juz wʌn læmp?/
dialogue.zh: 太亮了，我只開一盞檯燈好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One lamp is better for sleep.
dialogue.zh: 睡覺的時候開一盞燈比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, my eyes need that.
dialogue.zh: 正好，我的眼睛需要這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window looks at our yard.
dialogue.zh: 這扇窗戶對著我們家的院子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear birds in that tree.
dialogue.zh: 我聽到那棵樹上有鳥在叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug is still on his phone.
dialogue.zh: 道格還在講電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He calls his mother every trip.
dialogue.zh: 他每次出門都會打給他媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she doing better now?
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽現在好一些了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that winter was hard.
dialogue.zh: 好了，那個冬天真的很難熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can sit, the food can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn sɪt ðə fud kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們先坐一下，菜可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He needs five more minutes, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 他大概還需要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy warmed the tea pot already.
dialogue.zh: 艾米已經把茶壺溫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That smell makes me so hungry.
dialogue.zh: 這個味道讓我更餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea can wait, the food can't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti kæn weɪt, ðə fud kænt./
dialogue.zh: 茶可以等，飯不能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then feed me, I flew all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn fid mi, aɪ flu ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那就先餵我吧，我飛了一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One rule for today, no naps.
dialogue.zh: 今天有一條規矩：不可以午睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That hurts, but I will try.
dialogue.zh: 這個有點殘忍，但我試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep after nine, wake at six.
dialogue.zh: 九點以後睡，六點起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is kind, I can manage.
dialogue.zh: 六點還算客氣，我應付得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee after two is a no.
dialogue.zh: 兩點以後不喝咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep the tea coming, please.
dialogue.zh: 那就請你一直幫我續茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring my sister a gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju brɪŋ maɪ ˈsɪstər ə ɡɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 你有帶東西給我姊姊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a blue scarf in my case.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə blu skɑrf ɪn maɪ keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 有，我箱子裡放了一條藍色圍巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister asks about you always.
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊常常問起你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the scarf is for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr ðə skɑrf ɪz fər hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 幫我跟她說那條圍巾是給她的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you two still send cards?
dialogue.zh: 等等，你們兩個還在寄卡片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Postcards, yes, from every city.
dialogue.zh: 對啊，每一張都從不同的城市寄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your flight home is on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 你們回國的班機是週一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three nights, and I counted.
dialogue.zh: 三晚，我數得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three nights is not nearly enough.
dialogue.zh: 三晚怎麼算都不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work pulls us back, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 工作把我們拉回去，真對不起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me take you to your room.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi teɪk ju tu jʊr rum./
dialogue.zh: 我帶你去你的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lead, and I follow with bags.
dialogue.zh: 你帶路，我抱著行李跟來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This house feels loud at night.
dialogue.zh: 這房子一到晚上就顯得吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud is fine, our street is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ɪz faɪn, ˈaʊər strit ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 吵一點沒關係，我們那條街安靜得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guest room smells like soap.
dialogue.zh: 客房聞起來有肥皂的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your mom scrubbed it, I bet.
dialogue.zh: 一定是你媽媽刷的，我猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Need the bathroom before bed?
dialogue.zh: 上床前要先去洗手間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and then I find my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðɛn aɪ faɪnd maɪ bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 要，然後我就去找床躺平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home is yours now, make space.
dialogue.zh: 這個家現在也是你的，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for opening the door.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你為我們開這扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, your room for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz, jʊr rum fər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 就是這裡，你們現在的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big bed, and two pillows.
dialogue.zh: 一張大床，還有兩個枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug takes the side by the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌɡ teɪks ðə saɪd baɪ ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 道格睡靠牆的那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sleeps far from the door.
dialogue.zh: 他睡覺喜歡離門越遠越好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The closet doors stick a bit.
dialogue.zh: 衣櫃的門有一點卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push up, then it slides open.
dialogue.zh: 往上抬一點，它就能滑開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hangers hang inside there.
dialogue.zh: 裡面掛著六個衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for three days of clothes.
dialogue.zh: 三天的衣服夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One extra quilt is on the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈɛkstrə kwɪlt ɪz ɑn ðə tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 椅子上多放了一條備用被子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I run cold at night.
dialogue.zh: 正好，我睡覺怕冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan has three speeds.
dialogue.zh: 電風扇有三段速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the switch is on top?
dialogue.zh: 開關是在最上面那一顆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heater lives under the desk.
dialogue.zh: 電暖器就放在書桌下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night here feels cool to me.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的晚上我覺得有點涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The curtains block the early sun.
dialogue.zh: 窗簾擋得住早上的太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can sleep past six.
dialogue.zh: 那我就能睡過六點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wifi code sits on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwaɪˌwaɪ koʊd sɪts ɑn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 無線網路的密碼就在冰箱那張紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I text my daughter first.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我先把密碼傳給我女兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need a plug adapter?
dialogue.zh: 你需要插頭轉接器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My laptop takes the same shape.
dialogue.zh: 我的筆電插頭形狀一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two outlets sit by the lamp.
dialogue.zh: 床頭燈旁邊有兩個插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for my phone and watch.
dialogue.zh: 剛好給我掛手機和充手錶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A glass of water waits here.
dialogue.zh: 床邊放好了一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You thought of every small thing.
dialogue.zh: 小地方你全都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bathroom is past the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 洗手間在樓梯前面一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which towels are mine there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊哪兩條毛巾是給我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two on the low shelf.
dialogue.zh: 就是矮架上的那兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the extra ones for Doug?
dialogue.zh: 那道格多用的毛巾呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fresh toothbrush is in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛʃ ˈtuθˌbrʌʃ ɪz ɪn ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 全新的牙刷在杯子裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You even bought the soft kind.
dialogue.zh: 你居然還準備了軟毛的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not lock your door at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lɑk jʊr dɔr æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚上不要把房門鎖死。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will leave it open instead.
dialogue.zh: 我會讓它開著一條縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This key opens the front door.
dialogue.zh: 這把鑰匙開大門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How late do you lock the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ leɪt du ju lɑk ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們幾點會把門鎖上？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any hour, this is your home.
dialogue.zh: 幾點回來都行，這裡當你自己家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That line made me feel easy.
dialogue.zh: 你這句話讓我全身都放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mosquitoes wake up at dusk.
dialogue.zh: 天一黑蚊子就出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing I saw that spray.
dialogue.zh: 還好我看到了那瓶噴劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben will ask to play at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛn wɪl æsk tu pleɪ æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 小斌八點會想找你玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him I will say yes.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說我願意陪他玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed squeaks on one leg.
dialogue.zh: 床有一隻腳會嘎吱叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I never move in my sleep.
dialogue.zh: 我睡覺都不會翻身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firm pillows live on the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 硬一點的枕頭放在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sleep high, two under my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slip haɪ, tu ˈʌndər maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 我習慣枕高，要兩個疊著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want the fan on all night?
dialogue.zh: 風扇要整個晚上都開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low speed, and turned away.
dialogue.zh: 開最小那段，對著別的方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your suitcase stands on the rack.
dialogue.zh: 行李箱有行李架可以放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits, and stays closed.
dialogue.zh: 放得下，也關得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We start breakfast at seven.
dialogue.zh: 我們七點開始吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven is early, but noted.
dialogue.zh: 七點好早，不過我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall light stays on, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 走廊的燈會一直開著，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, I like a glow.
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，我睡覺喜歡有一點光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drawer is yours for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這個抽屜今晚給你用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty and clean, nice touch.
dialogue.zh: 空的又乾淨，你想得真細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two chargers live in the drawer.
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡有兩條充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine matches, so I am saved.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機孔一樣，得救了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window sticks on the left.
dialogue.zh: 左邊的窗戶有一點卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift and push, my trick works.
dialogue.zh: 邊抬邊推，我的老辦法有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunrise hits this room at five.
dialogue.zh: 五點太陽就照進這個房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing about the curtains.
dialogue.zh: 還好窗簾擋得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One wall is thin, you hear rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɔl ɪz θɪn, ju hɪr reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這面牆薄，會聽到雨聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain is my best sleep sound.
dialogue.zh: 雨聲是我最棒的睡覺音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge hums, is that fine?
dialogue.zh: 冰箱會嗡嗡響，你受得了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My old fan was much louder.
dialogue.zh: 我家那台舊電扇比這吵多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh sheets went on today.
dialogue.zh: 床單今天才換新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They smell like the sun outside.
dialogue.zh: 聞起來有外面曬過太陽的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the door stay wide open?
dialogue.zh: 房門要整個開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cracked is perfect for air.
dialogue.zh: 開一條縫通風剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two clean towels every single day.
dialogue.zh: 每天兩條乾淨毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You host like a small hotel.
dialogue.zh: 你招待客人像在開小飯店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wifi reaches this room well.
dialogue.zh: 這個房間收訊很滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bars, enough for video calls.
dialogue.zh: 兩格就夠我打視訊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One late call, then lights out.
dialogue.zh: 再打一通電話就關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I promised myself real sleep.
dialogue.zh: 我答應自己要好好睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch is close, come downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 快要開飯了，下樓吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me wash my face first.
dialogue.zh: 讓我先洗一下臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mirror hangs by the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 樓梯邊就掛著一面鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hair looks wild from the plane.
dialogue.zh: 搭完飛機頭髮全都亂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guest soap lives in a dish.
dialogue.zh: 客用的香皂放在小碟子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small dish, big thought.
dialogue.zh: 碟子不大，心意很足。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want me to move the desk?
dialogue.zh: 要我把書桌搬開一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No space needed, it sleeps two.
dialogue.zh: 不用多留空間，這床睡兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sets of hangers, one shelf.
dialogue.zh: 兩組衣架，共用一個格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug hangs nothing, I hang all.
dialogue.zh: 道格都不掛，衣服我全掛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark curtains, but thin edges.
dialogue.zh: 窗簾是深色的，不過邊會透光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clip them with these two magnets.
dialogue.zh: 用這兩個夾子夾住就不漏光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First night here, all new.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡的第一晚，什麼都陌生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always sleep badly at first.
dialogue.zh: 我到任何新地方前幾晚都睡不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks sit on the small table.
dialogue.zh: 小桌子上擺了點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peanuts, my night candy.
dialogue.zh: 花生就是我晚上的糖果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water refill is in the hall.
dialogue.zh: 走廊有壺水可以續。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really thought of night needs.
dialogue.zh: 你連半夜要用的都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bring your tray, no charge.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你端上來，完全不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I would like one more quilt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wʊd laɪk wʌn mɔr kwɪlt./
dialogue.zh: 那我想再多要一條被子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside is cool, the quilt is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɪz kul, ðə kwɪlt ɪz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 外面涼，可是被子很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel like a guest in a movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil laɪk ə ɡɛst ɪn ə ˈmuvi./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得自己像在電影裡當客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready for lunch, or need more?
dialogue.zh: 準備好吃飯了，還是要再待一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk me down, I am with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk mi daʊn, aɪ əm wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 你帶我下樓，我跟著你走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your tea corner waits downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 你們喝茶的那個角落在樓下等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea first, then lunch, then talk.
dialogue.zh: 先喝茶，再吃午餐，然後慢慢聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is our tea corner.
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是我們家喝茶的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, one pot, one tray.
dialogue.zh: 兩個杯子、一壺茶、一個托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy learned to pour it properly.
dialogue.zh: 艾米學會了怎麼正確地倒茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me first, I will copy.
dialogue.zh: 你先示範一次，我在旁邊學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, warm the pot with hot water.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, wɔrm ðə pɑt wɪð hɑt ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 先用熱水把茶壺溫過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why warm it, is it dirty?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要溫壺，它不乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A warm pot keeps the tea sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm pɑt kips ðə ti swit./
dialogue.zh: 溫過的壺會讓茶喝起來更甘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same as coffee, I get it.
dialogue.zh: 跟咖啡一樣的道理，我懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One spoon of leaves, no more.
dialogue.zh: 一匙茶葉，不要多放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose leaves, not a paper bag?
dialogue.zh: 散裝的茶葉，不是茶包？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper bags are for one cup.
dialogue.zh: 茶包只能泡一杯而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This pot gives me three rounds?
dialogue.zh: 這一壺可以泡三道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three rounds, maybe four today.
dialogue.zh: 三道，今天說不定四道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, tea gets water again?
dialogue.zh: 等等，茶還能夠加水？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water boils, leaves stay in.
dialogue.zh: 水燒開，茶葉留在壺裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In Chicago we throw them out.
dialogue.zh: 在芝加哥我們泡一次就倒掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count thirty seconds, then pour.
dialogue.zh: 數三十秒，然後倒出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted wrong, it is dark.
dialogue.zh: 我數錯了，這杯泡到發黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strong tea is fine with cake.
dialogue.zh: 茶濃一點配點心剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who fried these, your mom?
dialogue.zh: 這些是誰炸的，你媽媽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She woke at five to fry these.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi woʊk æt faɪv tu fraɪ ðiz./
dialogue.zh: 她五點就起來炸這些餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five is my work alarm too.
dialogue.zh: 五點也是我上班的鬧鐘時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try one while it is warm.
dialogue.zh: 試吃一個，還溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The skin flakes on my fingers.
dialogue.zh: 外皮在我手指上就碎開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cup it in both palms, so.
dialogue.zh: 用兩邊手掌這樣托住它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, like a small bird?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣嗎，像捧著小鳥？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, crumbs fall but taste good.
dialogue.zh: 對，會掉碎屑，可是好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will catch them on my plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kætʃ ðɛm ɑn maɪ pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我會用盤子接住那些屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In our home the guest eats first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈaʊər hoʊm ðə ɡɛst its fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我們家的規矩是客人先吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then today I eat first?
dialogue.zh: 那今天我就能先吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour for me, and I pour back.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr fər mi, ænd aɪ pɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 你幫我倒一杯，我再回倒給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My wrist hurts from this tiny cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪst hɜrts frʌm ðɪs ˈtaɪni kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 這種小杯子拿久了手腕會痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny cups keep the heat close.
dialogue.zh: 小杯子才留得住熱氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours hold a whole bowl, though.
dialogue.zh: 我們家的杯子大得能裝一碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar? Cream? Or plain, friend?
dialogue.zh: 要糖、要奶，還是純茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain, please, I want the leaf.
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不加，我要茶葉的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good answer, no sugar here.
dialogue.zh: 答得好，我們這裡不放糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about milk in my tea?
dialogue.zh: 那我的茶可以加牛奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk kills this tea, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 加了牛奶這壺茶就白泡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then straight it is, one sip.
dialogue.zh: 那就純喝，先小口嚐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sip slow, it burns your tongue.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢喝，會燙到舌頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, I took a big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu leɪt, aɪ tʊk ə bɪɡ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 來不及了，我剛剛喝了一大口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not laugh, my son does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt læf, maɪ sʌn dʌz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 別笑，我兒子也會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boys learn that the hard way.
dialogue.zh: 小男孩都是這樣學會的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plum is sour, try a slice.
dialogue.zh: 梅子很酸，試吃一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes just closed by themselves.
dialogue.zh: 我酸到眼睛自己閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Melon seeds are the slow snack.
dialogue.zh: 瓜子是最耗時間的零嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug cracked ten in one minute.
dialogue.zh: 道格一分鐘就嗑了十顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he learn that in the army?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hi lərn ðæt ɪn ði ˈɑrmi?/
dialogue.zh: 他這招是在部隊練的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, from his grandfather's shop.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是他阿公的店裡學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More tea, or a fresh pot?
dialogue.zh: 要續茶，還是換一壺新的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh one, this went cold fast.
dialogue.zh: 換新的，這壺一下就涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second pot tastes softer, see.
dialogue.zh: 第二壺喝起來比較柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, less bite on my tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz, lɛs baɪt ɑn maɪ tʌŋ./
dialogue.zh: 真的是，舌頭上的澀味變少了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your mother drink black tea?
dialogue.zh: 你媽媽也喝茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two every day, no milk.
dialogue.zh: 她每天兩杯，都不加奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black tea is strong for mornings.
dialogue.zh: 紅茶濃，適合早上提神。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She drinks it, and sleeps fine.
dialogue.zh: 她照樣喝，也照樣睡得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How late is it in Chicago?
dialogue.zh: 芝加哥現在幾點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten thirty, all asleep by now.
dialogue.zh: 十點半，那邊早就睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your phone keeps buzzing, look.
dialogue.zh: 你的手機一直在震，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it wait, I am here.
dialogue.zh: 讓它先等著吧，我人在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cookie more, the salty one?
dialogue.zh: 再一塊餅乾，要鹹的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salty snack, black tea, perfect.
dialogue.zh: 鹹餅乾配無糖茶，最對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray is heavy, let me.
dialogue.zh: 托盤很重，我來端。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay seated, I have this one.
dialogue.zh: 你坐著就好，這個我拿得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, bring two napkins, please.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，幫我拿兩張餐巾紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He dropped one, but he tried.
dialogue.zh: 他掉了一張，不過他很努力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eat slowly, your stomach is asleep.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，你的胃還在睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It woke up for the bean cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt woʊkt ʌp fər ðə bin keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 吃到豆沙餅它就醒來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take photos of food?
dialogue.zh: 你會先幫食物拍照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, my phone is full of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz, maɪ foʊn ɪz fʊl ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一定拍，我手機裡全都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me that tray photo too.
dialogue.zh: 那張托盤的照片也傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, that is almost art.
dialogue.zh: 給，擺著就像一幅小畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea stains the wood, see this spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ti steɪnz ðə wʊd, si ðɪs spɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 茶在木桌上留了印子，看到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it now, cloth is here.
dialogue.zh: 趕快擦，抹布就在這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes gone, time flies.
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘過去了，時間過好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lunch waits, the pot steams now.
dialogue.zh: 午餐在等，鍋子正冒著熱氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last cup, then the table.
dialogue.zh: 最後一杯，然後換到餐桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pour, you carry the cakes.
dialogue.zh: 我倒茶，你把點心端過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your tray has a handle, right?
dialogue.zh: 你的托盤有把手，對不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hand is plenty, watch me.
dialogue.zh: 一隻手就夠了，看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You learned our tea in one day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɜrnd ˈaʊər ti ɪn wʌn deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你一天就把我們家的茶學會了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just copied what you did.
dialogue.zh: 我只是照著你做的樣子學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug is eating all the seeds.
dialogue.zh: 道格把瓜子都快吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save ten for the game tonight.
dialogue.zh: 留十顆，今晚玩遊戲時嗑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Game night is Saturday, remember?
dialogue.zh: 玩桌遊是週六晚上，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday, yes, I mixed the days.
dialogue.zh: 週六對，我把日子搞混了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More snacks, or is this enough?
dialogue.zh: 還要點心嗎，還是這些夠了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for now, my lap is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf fər naʊ, maɪ læp ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 現在夠了，我腿上已經堆滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea for the road, I packed two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti fər ðə roʊd, aɪ pækt tu./
dialogue.zh: 我另外收了兩罐路上喝的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the plane? You thought ahead?
dialogue.zh: 是留給飛機上嗎？你想好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tin of leaves, not bottles.
dialogue.zh: 是茶葉罐，不是裝瓶的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brew it hot, drink it slow.
dialogue.zh: 泡熱一點，喝慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tray was my grandmother's.
dialogue.zh: 這個托盤是我阿嬤留下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old things hold the best stories.
dialogue.zh: 舊東西裡面裝著最好的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes, then we call lunch.
dialogue.zh: 再五分鐘，就要喊吃飯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chopsticks, right? I need a plan.
dialogue.zh: 要用筷子對吧？我得先想個辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will do fine, just watch hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl du faɪn, dʒʌst wɑtʃ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 你會做得很好，只要看我的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I watched ten years of videos.
dialogue.zh: 我看了十年的教學影片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is your seat, by Ben.
dialogue.zh: 你的座位就在小斌旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A plate, a bowl, two sticks.
dialogue.zh: 一個盤子、一個碗、兩根筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sticks, and no fork?
dialogue.zh: 兩根棍子，然後沒有叉子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fork hides in the drawer.
dialogue.zh: 叉子都收在抽屜裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this meal needs chopsticks.
dialogue.zh: 不行，這頓飯要用筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then teach me, I am ready.
dialogue.zh: 那你教我，我準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the low end, not the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə loʊ ɛnd, nɑt ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 握下面那段，不要抓最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a pencil? I tried that.
dialogue.zh: 像拿鉛筆那樣嗎？我試過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pencil is close, but looser.
dialogue.zh: 像鉛筆沒錯，不過要更鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose is my style anyway.
dialogue.zh: 我本來就握不緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One stick stays, one moves.
dialogue.zh: 下面那根不動，上面那根才動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine both move, it is chaos.
dialogue.zh: 我的兩根都在動，一片混亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest them on the small holder.
dialogue.zh: 不用的時候擱在小筷架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a small bridge for them.
dialogue.zh: 像一座小橋，讓筷子歇著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not stand them in rice.
dialogue.zh: 不要把筷子直直插在飯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why, is that bad luck?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼，那樣會不吉利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only funerals use that pose.
dialogue.zh: 那種擺法是拜拜時才用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they rest flat, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 那我就讓它們平平躺著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap nothing, no bowl drums.
dialogue.zh: 什麼都別敲，碗不是鼓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug drums on his bowl at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌɡ drʌmz ɑn hɪz boʊl æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 道格在家就會敲碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point at no one with the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt æt noʊ wʌn wɪð ðə tɪps./
dialogue.zh: 不要用筷子的尖端指人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I pointed at Doug.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛用筷子指道格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the serving pair for his plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈsɜrvɪŋ pɛr fər hɪz pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 夾菜給他要用公用那一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Public sticks, I like that.
dialogue.zh: 公用的筷子，這個說法我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch my thumb, it does most.
dialogue.zh: 看我的大拇指，它最忙碌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumb down, fingers up?
dialogue.zh: 拇指往下、其餘手指往上？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close, now lift one peanut.
dialogue.zh: 很接近了，現在夾一顆花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It jumped across the whole table.
dialogue.zh: 它一跳，跳到桌子那頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben caught it, no hands!
dialogue.zh: 小斌接住了，沒有用手！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids are fast, I am slow.
dialogue.zh: 小孩快，我慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squeeze soft, do not stab.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕夾住，不要用插的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stabbing is my first plan.
dialogue.zh: 用插的就是我的第一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tofu ball is the boss.
dialogue.zh: 那顆豆腐丸就是最後關卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be honest, a spoon would help.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，有支湯匙會更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spoons are allowed, take one.
dialogue.zh: 湯匙當然可以用，拿一支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved by the metal friend.
dialogue.zh: 我這位金屬朋友救了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the bowl, do not bend.
dialogue.zh: 把碗端起來，不要彎腰去吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In America we keep it flat.
dialogue.zh: 在美國我們都讓碗平放在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In this house lifting is fine.
dialogue.zh: 在我們家端起來吃沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This feels rude and fun.
dialogue.zh: 這樣感覺很沒禮貌，可是好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass the dish, not the sticks.
dialogue.zh: 要傳菜就傳盤子，別傳筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug just passed me his pair.
dialogue.zh: 道格剛把他的筷子遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wants the soy, I think.
dialogue.zh: 他應該是想要醬油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He learned three words on the plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lɜrnd θri wɜrdz ɑn ðə pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他在飛機上學會三個中文詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soy sauce, garlic, chili oil.
dialogue.zh: 醬油、蒜泥、辣椒油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My nose is ready for them.
dialogue.zh: 我的鼻子已經準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little chili, you will cry.
dialogue.zh: 辣醬放一點點，你會哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicago chili is candy to me.
dialogue.zh: 芝加哥的辣醬對我就像糖果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, show her the grip.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，幫阿姨示範怎麼握。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He holds them like a pro.
dialogue.zh: 他拿起來像個專家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four years old, better than me.
dialogue.zh: 他四歲，握得比我好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He learned by watching you.
dialogue.zh: 他是看著你們學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice grains are the real test.
dialogue.zh: 一粒一粒的白飯才是真正考驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I want the spoon again.
dialogue.zh: 那我只能再找湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No spoon for rice here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡吃飯不配湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do you stop the spill?
dialogue.zh: 那你們怎麼防止飯粒掉下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cup your hand under the bowl.
dialogue.zh: 手掌彎起來在碗下面接著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I caught three grains, yes!
dialogue.zh: 我夾到三粒了，太好了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One peanut still beats me.
dialogue.zh: 還是有一顆花生贏過我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try cold peanuts, they sit still.
dialogue.zh: 試試涼的花生，它們不會滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are teaching now, I see.
dialogue.zh: 現在換你在教我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tip learned, I pass it on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tɪp lɜrnd, aɪ pæs ɪt ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 學到一招，我就傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your elbow off the table.
dialogue.zh: 手肘不要靠在桌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old habit from my dad.
dialogue.zh: 這是我爸爸留下的老習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chew with your mouth closed, friend.
dialogue.zh: 吃東西要閉著嘴巴，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I know, I am trying.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, aɪ noʊ, aɪ əm ˈtraɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我在努力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say something nice about the food.
dialogue.zh: 誇一句這桌菜吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This tofu wins, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 這盤豆腐最好吃，不騙你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup spoons go out, not in.
dialogue.zh: 喝湯時湯匙往外推，不是往裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out it goes, then, look.
dialogue.zh: 好，那就往外，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plates pass to the left.
dialogue.zh: 盤子要往左邊傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left it is, I was wrong.
dialogue.zh: 那就往左，是我搞錯方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug finished all of his rice.
dialogue.zh: 道格把飯吃得一粒都不剩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He grew up on a farm.
dialogue.zh: 他是農場長大的小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty plates are the best praise.
dialogue.zh: 吃光是最好的誇獎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I take one more serving.
dialogue.zh: 那我就再多要一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More rice lives in the big pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr raɪs lɪvz ɪn ðə bɪɡ pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 要添飯都在那口大鍋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more scoop, no shame.
dialogue.zh: 再多舀一勺，不用害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you full, or still hungry?
dialogue.zh: 你飽了，還是還餓著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full, but that fish looks good.
dialogue.zh: 飽了，但那塊魚看起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave room, dessert waits inside.
dialogue.zh: 留點空間，甜點還在廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dessert with chopsticks? Never.
dialogue.zh: 要用筷子吃甜點？我才不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We cut that cake with a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʌt ðæt keɪk wɪð ə spun./
dialogue.zh: 我們用湯匙切那塊蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, my hands need a break.
dialogue.zh: 你看，我的手需要休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do your fingers feel now?
dialogue.zh: 你的手指現在感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sore, but proud, I think.
dialogue.zh: 有點痠，不過我挺自豪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour rest, then the album.
dialogue.zh: 休息一小時，然後看相簿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The album? Yes, bring it out.
dialogue.zh: 相簿？好啊，拿出來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben beat you at peanuts, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 小斌夾花生贏你了，先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him I train after nap.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說我睡醒午覺再練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pair of chopsticks is yours.
dialogue.zh: 這一雙筷子送你帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gift? For me, from you?
dialogue.zh: 禮物？是給我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wood ones, not plastic, see.
dialogue.zh: 是木頭的，不是塑膠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will name this pair Ben.
dialogue.zh: 我要叫這一雙筷子小斌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch is meal one of five.
dialogue.zh: 午餐是五頓飯裡的第一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five meals at your table?
dialogue.zh: 在你們家一起吃五頓？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy planned each single one.
dialogue.zh: 每一頓都是艾米事先排好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I save my stomach space.
dialogue.zh: 那我得替我的胃留點地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash hands, the album is out.
dialogue.zh: 去洗手吧，相簿已經攤開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One napkin first, I am messy.
dialogue.zh: 先給我一張紙巾，我吃得亂七八糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The album sits on my lap.
dialogue.zh: 相簿攤開在我的腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real paper photos? Wow.
dialogue.zh: 真的紙本照片？哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One book, two hundred faces.
dialogue.zh: 一本相簿，兩百張臉孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do we start, here?
dialogue.zh: 我們從哪一頁翻起？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one is my mother.
dialogue.zh: 這張是我媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the garden, with tomatoes?
dialogue.zh: 在院子裡，旁邊是番茄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She grows food, not flowers.
dialogue.zh: 她種的是菜，不是花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine kills every green thing.
dialogue.zh: 我種什麼就死什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her hands look like yours, see?
dialogue.zh: 她的手跟你的好像，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, I am not that old!
dialogue.zh: 別鬧，我沒那麼老！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This old man was my dad.
dialogue.zh: 這位老先生是我爸爸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He holds a huge fish!
dialogue.zh: 他抱著一條超大的魚！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He fished forty straight Sundays.
dialogue.zh: 他釣魚釣了四十個週日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty! Did he eat them all?
dialogue.zh: 四十次！他都吃掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He gave them all away.
dialogue.zh: 他通通送給鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A generous man in an old shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdʒɛnərəs mæn ɪn ən oʊld ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 穿舊襯衫的慷慨男人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy here acted in her school play.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪmi hɪr ˈæktɪd ɪn hɜr skul pleɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這張是艾米在學校演話劇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wears a hat? A tree?
dialogue.zh: 她戴帽子？還是扮演一棵樹？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She played a tree, one line.
dialogue.zh: 她演一棵樹，只有一句台詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I thought trees had no lines.
dialogue.zh: 我以為樹是不用講字的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben's first day, one big bag.
dialogue.zh: 小斌第一天上學，背了一個大包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His face says no school.
dialogue.zh: 他的臉在說：我不要上學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He cried for two whole minutes.
dialogue.zh: 他整整哭了兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids bounce back, look at him.
dialogue.zh: 小孩恢復得快，你看他現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This puppy is our Mochi.
dialogue.zh: 這隻小乳狗就是我們的麻糬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That round thing was a dog?
dialogue.zh: 那團圓圓的東西居然是狗？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shoe box was her first bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃu bɑks wʊz hɜr fɜrst bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 她第一次睡的是鞋子紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mochi sounds like a snack.
dialogue.zh: 麻糬這個名字聽起來就像點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We named her for rice cake.
dialogue.zh: 我們用米糕替她取名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug eats rice cake, mind Mochi.
dialogue.zh: 道格愛吃米糕，那得看緊麻糬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, here we are at school.
dialogue.zh: 你看，這張是我們還在讀書的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is us, ten years back!
dialogue.zh: 是我們耶，十年前的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hair then was a crime.
dialogue.zh: 你當時那顆頭髮真是災難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your shirt had holes, I checked.
dialogue.zh: 你的襯衫上有破洞，我數過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We ate at that corner store.
dialogue.zh: 我們那時候都去轉角那家店吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noodles at one in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 凌晨一點還在那裡吃麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You paid that one, always you.
dialogue.zh: 那一次也是你買單，每次都是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten times, I kept the list.
dialogue.zh: 十次，我有好好記帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That list still lives on paper?
dialogue.zh: 那份名單居然還寫在紙上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One page, folded in my book.
dialogue.zh: 一頁，摺起來夾在我的書裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wall photo is our wedding.
dialogue.zh: 牆上這張是我們結婚那天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many guests sat down?
dialogue.zh: 那天坐下來多少賓客？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty, and it rained hard.
dialogue.zh: 六十位，而且下了一場大雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain at a wedding is lucky.
dialogue.zh: 婚禮上下雨是好兆頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben came two months after that.
dialogue.zh: 小斌在那之後兩個月出生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So he missed all the cake.
dialogue.zh: 所以他完全沒吃到蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom kept your cards in here.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽把妳的卡片都收在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is from our tenth city.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz frʌm ˈaʊər tɛnθ ˈsɪti./
dialogue.zh: 那張是我們第十個城市寄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin lives in that house.
dialogue.zh: 我表哥住在那間房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The house behind the red gate?
dialogue.zh: 是紅色鐵門後面那一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he grills every summer night.
dialogue.zh: 對，他每年夏天晚上都烤肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We bring a salad, right?
dialogue.zh: 我們負責帶沙拉，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print this one, take it home.
dialogue.zh: 這張我洗出來給你帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For Emma? She loves photos.
dialogue.zh: 是給艾瑪的嗎？她最愛照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is Emma at school now?
dialogue.zh: 艾瑪在學校現在怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She plays flute, loudly, badly.
dialogue.zh: 她在吹長笛，很大聲，也不太好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine years old, loud is normal.
dialogue.zh: 九歲嘛，大聲很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She stayed home with grandma.
dialogue.zh: 這趟她留下來陪奶奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her grandma watches her alone?
dialogue.zh: 她奶奶一個人在照顧她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors away, so easy.
dialogue.zh: 就住隔兩戶，方便得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the mountain we climbed.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們去爬過的那座山。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That tent was all on you.
dialogue.zh: 整頂帳篷都是你一個人在背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once, and my back said no.
dialogue.zh: 背了一次，我的腰就說不要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We slept in that car, yes.
dialogue.zh: 那天晚上我們就睡在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold feet, hot thermos.
dialogue.zh: 腳是冷的，保溫瓶是熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cocoa at five in a park.
dialogue.zh: 清晨五點在公園裡喝熱可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos make the time fold up.
dialogue.zh: 照片會讓時間摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel ten years younger now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在覺得自己年輕了十歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up, let us take one.
dialogue.zh: 站起來，我們拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the album open, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把相簿打開一起入鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug, come here for this one!
dialogue.zh: 道格，這張要過來一起拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will hold Ben, I count three.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl hoʊld bɛn, aɪ kaʊnt θri./
dialogue.zh: 他會抱著小斌，我數三下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile, not so many teeth.
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，牙齒不用露那麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You take the worst photos.
dialogue.zh: 你最會把人拍得難看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, and then two more.
dialogue.zh: 再一張，然後再來兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grinning too much, cheeks hurt.
dialogue.zh: 我笑到臉都痠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send them tonight, our wifi is quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ðɛm təˈnaɪt, ˈaʊər ˈwaɪˌwaɪ ɪz kwɪk./
dialogue.zh: 今晚就傳過去，我們網路很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in a paper envelope.
dialogue.zh: 也放進紙信封給我吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write on the back, always.
dialogue.zh: 一定要在照片背面寫字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Date, place, and all the names.
dialogue.zh: 日期、地點，還有在場的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This empty frame waits for us.
dialogue.zh: 這個空相框在等一張新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the chopsticks photo, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 也許可以放你學筷子那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You held them well today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天筷子握得很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tofu ball made it safe.
dialogue.zh: 有一顆豆腐丸平安送進嘴裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask for the album any time.
dialogue.zh: 想翻相簿隨時跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will flip it page by page.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl flɪp ɪt peɪdʒ baɪ peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我會一頁一頁慢慢翻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom, show them your last page.
dialogue.zh: 媽，把最後一頁給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She kept it empty on purpose.
dialogue.zh: 她是故意把那一頁留空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That blank waits for today.
dialogue.zh: 那片空白就是在等今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then print three, not one.
dialogue.zh: 那就要洗三張，不是一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two travel home, one stays here.
dialogue.zh: 兩張你們帶回去，一張貼在我們牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug keeps one for Emma.
dialogue.zh: 道格要留一張給艾瑪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea again, or a short rest?
dialogue.zh: 要再泡一壺，還是先休息一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No nap, you set that rule.
dialogue.zh: 不能午睡，規矩是你定的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner tonight is at six thirty.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的飯六點半開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We help, just tell us where.
dialogue.zh: 我們會幫忙，叫我們做什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peas and corn, you two shell them.
dialogue.phonetic: /piz ænd kɔrn, ju tu ʃɛl ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 豌豆跟玉米，你們兩個負責剝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chopsticks or hands for corn?
dialogue.zh: 吃玉米要用筷子還是用手？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands, always hands for corn.
dialogue.zh: 手，吃玉米永遠用雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like that kind of rule.
dialogue.zh: 這才是我會遵守的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday night, the box is out.
dialogue.zh: 週六晚上，遊戲盒拿出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Island Trip, our four players.
dialogue.zh: 「小島旅行」，我們四個人玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rules say one hour.
dialogue.zh: 說明上寫一小時結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took us two last time.
dialogue.zh: 上次我們玩了兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four cards each, then a die.
dialogue.zh: 每人先拿四張牌，再擲骰子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I rolled first, watch this.
dialogue.zh: 我先擲，你看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A six, you lucky guest.
dialogue.zh: 擲到六點，你這個客人運氣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move five boats, then draw.
dialogue.zh: 五艘船前進，然後摸牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not peek at my hand.
dialogue.zh: 不要偷看我的牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only see the blue back.
dialogue.zh: 我只看得到藍色的牌背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue is trade, red is rain.
dialogue.zh: 藍色是交易，紅色是下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain stops my little boat.
dialogue.zh: 下雨就擋了我的小船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben watches us, chin on hands.
dialogue.zh: 小斌趴在桌上看我們玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants a seat badly.
dialogue.zh: 他很想要一個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids sit out till nine.
dialogue.zh: 小孩九點之前不能上桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He snoozes on the rug there.
dialogue.zh: 他在地毯上睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet now, the dice roll.
dialogue.zh: 安靜，骰子要滾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fell under the chair.
dialogue.zh: 它掉到椅子下面去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy keeps the score sheet.
dialogue.zh: 艾米在旁邊記分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pencils, and no erasing?
dialogue.zh: 兩支鉛筆，而且不能擦掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it wrong, live with it.
dialogue.zh: 寫錯就一直錯著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our house law.
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們家的家規。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your harbor sits on my road.
dialogue.zh: 你的港口正擋在我的航線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay me one coin to pass.
dialogue.zh: 要過去就給我一枚錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins are fake, but I feel pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ɑr feɪk, bʌt aɪ fil peɪn./
dialogue.zh: 錢是假的，但我心痛是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play angry, it suits you.
dialogue.zh: 你就適合氣呼呼地玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trade you a red for blue.
dialogue.zh: 我拿紅色的跟你換藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blues, that is greedy.
dialogue.zh: 開口要兩張，你太貪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug taught me that move.
dialogue.zh: 這一招是道格教我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He read it in the box.
dialogue.zh: 他是自己看盒裡的說明讀來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round one goes to Linda.
dialogue.zh: 第一輪是琳達贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our guest wins, of course.
dialogue.zh: 客人獲勝，當然是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She counted the boats twice.
dialogue.zh: 她把船來回數了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair play, I checked too.
dialogue.zh: 很公平，我也有跟著核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round two, new cards, same rules.
dialogue.zh: 第二輪，重新洗牌，規則不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I shuffle, you cut the deck.
dialogue.zh: 我來洗牌，你負責切牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug cut deep, he is bold.
dialogue.zh: 道格切在很後面，他大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bold wins one round here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡大膽可以贏一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more minutes, the clock says.
dialogue.zh: 鐘上說還有兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our games need no timer.
dialogue.zh: 我們玩遊戲不需要倒數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The box says six and up.
dialogue.zh: 盒子建議六歲以上才玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben is four, and he stayed.
dialogue.zh: 小斌才四歲，他也撐著不睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winner picks the next game.
dialogue.zh: 贏的人可以挑下一個遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I choose a card game.
dialogue.zh: 那我就要選撲克牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rounds done, ten o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 兩輪打完，已經十點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our bed calls from upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 我們的床在樓上呼喚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards in the box, all of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz ɪn ðə bɑks, ɔl ʌv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 牌通通收進盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two went under the sofa.
dialogue.zh: 有兩張滾到沙發下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get them tomorrow, come here.
dialogue.zh: 明天再撿，你先過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben sleeps, carry him up.
dialogue.zh: 小斌睡著了，抱他上樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He weighs a whole bag of rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪz ə hoʊl bæɡ ʌv raɪs./
dialogue.zh: 他重得像一整袋白米。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dads train for this, trust me.
dialogue.zh: 爸爸們都在練這個抱法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rule book is closed now.
dialogue.zh: 說明書合起來收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page four was folded already.
dialogue.zh: 第四頁早就被人摺起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Linda, you hid a card.
dialogue.zh: 琳達，你藏了一張牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof? Look at my empty hands.
dialogue.zh: 證據？看我的兩隻空手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fell from your sleeve there.
dialogue.zh: 它剛剛從你的袖口滑下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this round owes me a win.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs raʊnd oʊz mi ə wɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那這局就該算我贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, jet lag guest.
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，時差還沒倒的客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hours, then your eggs.
dialogue.zh: 睡六小時，然後來吃你的蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fan on, window closed.
dialogue.zh: 電扇開著，窗戶關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towels are where I left them?
dialogue.zh: 毛巾還在我放著的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fresh ones, on the chair.
dialogue.zh: 兩條新的，擱在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This room needs a guest bell.
dialogue.zh: 這個房間少了一個服務鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ding! Here is your water.
dialogue.zh: 叮！你的水來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best service, five stars.
dialogue.zh: 服務最好，五顆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister wore your scarf today.
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊今天戴了你送的圍巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then my bag carried something right.
dialogue.zh: 那我的箱子總算帶對了東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water kettle waits by your door.
dialogue.zh: 熱水壺放在你房門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A night light too? You think of all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə naɪt laɪt tu? ju θɪŋk ʌv ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 連小夜燈都有？你想完全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug slept through round two.
dialogue.zh: 道格在第二輪睡過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen hours beats any game.
dialogue.zh: 十四個小時的時差贏過一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your two pillows are still flat.
dialogue.zh: 你們那兩個枕頭還是平平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we fight the clock.
dialogue.zh: 還沒睡，我們還在跟時間打仗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday is almost over.
dialogue.zh: 星期六就快過完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday dinner, then packing.
dialogue.zh: 週日吃晚餐，然後收行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will cook the big pot.
dialogue.zh: 我要煮那一口大鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup pot? With all the plates?
dialogue.zh: 火鍋嗎？要擺滿盤子的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the table for six.
dialogue.zh: 對，餐桌要擺六個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six? We are only four.
dialogue.zh: 六個？我們才四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom, Ben, Amy, Doug, me.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽、小斌、艾米、道格，還有我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And me, so six chairs.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個我，剛好六張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben sits on a booster.
dialogue.zh: 小斌要坐在墊高的坐墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will drop beef in his lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl drɑp bif ɪn hɪz læp./
dialogue.zh: 他肯定會把牛肉掉在腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack the napkins in threes.
dialogue.zh: 餐巾紙三個一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chopsticks in sets of two.
dialogue.zh: 筷子兩支一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom's page waits for the chopsticks photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑmz peɪdʒ weɪts fɔr ðə ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 媽媽那一頁，還在等妳學筷子那張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will teach Emma next.
dialogue.zh: 我下一個要教艾瑪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cloth waits, folded, clean.
dialogue.zh: 桌巾收好了，折得整整齊齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one, or the plain?
dialogue.zh: 要藍色那條，還是素色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue, it hides the soy spots.
dialogue.zh: 藍色，可以蓋掉醬油的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You planned dinner at game night.
dialogue.zh: 你玩遊戲時就在排行程了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five meals, one more left.
dialogue.zh: 一共五頓，還剩最後一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday dinner is the fifth.
dialogue.zh: 週日晚餐是第五頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, thank our guests tonight.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，跟客人說聲謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waves, eyes already closed.
dialogue.zh: 他揮了手，眼睛早就閉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet house, ten thirty now.
dialogue.zh: 房子安靜下來，現在十點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My body thinks it is morning.
dialogue.zh: 我的身體還以為現在是早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep, my far away friend.
dialogue.zh: 去睡吧，我遠道來的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will dream about that tofu.
dialogue.zh: 我大概會夢到那顆豆腐丸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not book a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 別去訂餐廳的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wanted to treat you tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚想請你們吃一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay home, this pot is for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ hoʊm, ðɪs pɑt ɪz fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 留在家裡吧，這鍋是為你們煮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you sure? We can drive.
dialogue.zh: 你們確定嗎？我們可以開車出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure as soup is warm.
dialogue.zh: 很確定，就像湯一定是熱的那樣確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we stay, coats back on hooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi steɪ, koʊts bæk ɑn hʊks./
dialogue.zh: 那我們留下，外套再掛回鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six chairs, we counted twice.
dialogue.zh: 六張椅子，我們數過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mom sits at the far end.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽坐在桌子的另一端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pot, two soups inside.
dialogue.zh: 一口鍋，中間隔成兩種湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half is clear, half is fire.
dialogue.zh: 一半是清湯，一半辣到燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben eats from the clear side.
dialogue.zh: 小斌都吃清湯那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug wants all of the fire.
dialogue.zh: 道格想把辣的那邊整鍋端走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beef cooks in ten seconds.
dialogue.zh: 牛肉燙十秒就可以吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten, or you chew a shoe.
dialogue.zh: 十秒就好，不然咬起來像鞋底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swish it with your sticks.
dialogue.zh: 用你的筷子在湯裡晃著涮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My chopsticks are ready now.
dialogue.zh: 我的筷子已經進入狀況了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at you, no more student.
dialogue.zh: 看看你，已經不是初學者了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me credit, I practiced hard.
dialogue.zh: 給我點掌聲嘛，我練得很勤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cabbage first, it sweetens broth.
dialogue.zh: 高麗菜先下鍋，湯就會變甘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mushrooms need eight minutes.
dialogue.zh: 香菇要煮滿八分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fish balls float when done.
dialogue.zh: 魚丸浮起來就是熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine sank to the pot bottom.
dialogue.zh: 我那顆還沉在鍋底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fish them out with a spoon.
dialogue.zh: 用湯匙把丸子撈出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tools, one happy guest.
dialogue.zh: 兩樣工具，換一個開心的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sauce: soy, sesame, garlic.
dialogue.zh: 醬料有醬油、芝麻醬、蒜泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is half chili oil.
dialogue.zh: 我那碗一半都是辣油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it well, that is all.
dialogue.zh: 攪一攪就好，不用喝它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doug drank a full cup.
dialogue.zh: 道格已經喝掉整整一碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He was brave at lunch too.
dialogue.zh: 他午餐的時候也這麼勇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His lips are red right now.
dialogue.zh: 他的嘴唇現在還是紅紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noodles go in at the end.
dialogue.zh: 麵條要最後才下鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the soup tastes like home.
dialogue.zh: 那種湯喝起來就像家的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom saved the beef plate.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽特地幫妳留了一盤牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her I take two plates.
dialogue.zh: 幫我說我要兩盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says two, not three.
dialogue.zh: 她說兩盤，不可以三盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I am still polite.
dialogue.zh: 成交，我還是很有禮貌的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toast with tea, no wine here.
dialogue.zh: 我們用茶當酒，桌上沒有酒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then raise your little cup.
dialogue.zh: 那就請舉起你的小杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To Linda, who crossed an ocean.
dialogue.zh: 敬琳達，她遠渡重洋過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To your open door, always.
dialogue.zh: 也敬你們永遠開著的大門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, no beef flying, please.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，牛肉不可以飛來飛去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He aimed at his own mouth.
dialogue.zh: 他是對著自己的嘴巴瞄準。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam fogs my glasses.
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣把我的眼鏡都霧化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them off, the food is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɛm ɔf, ðə fud ɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 先摘下來，沒有一盤菜會跑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your chopstick rest sits empty.
dialogue.zh: 你的筷架上什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I lay them across the bowl.
dialogue.zh: 我把它們橫放在碗口上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that is allowed here.
dialogue.zh: 很好，在我們家這樣是允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep learning house rules.
dialogue.zh: 我不斷在學你家的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More broth, my cup is low.
dialogue.zh: 再添一點湯，我的碗快見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pour, you taught me well.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你倒，這是你的教學成果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more plate of tofu.
dialogue.zh: 再來一盤豆腐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one you failed at lunch?
dialogue.zh: 就是你午餐夾不太到的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That ball fell on Ben.
dialogue.zh: 那顆丸子之前掉在小斌身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He ate it off the floor.
dialogue.zh: 他撿起來就直接吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is meal five of five.
dialogue.zh: 這是第五頓，也是最後一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will eat real slow.
dialogue.zh: 那我就要吃得很慢很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amy made the last pot big.
dialogue.zh: 艾米把最後這一鍋煮得特別大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leftovers for the plane?
dialogue.zh: 吃不完的可以帶上飛機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I packed a box, see there.
dialogue.zh: 我已經裝好一個餐盒，在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice, beef, and two small cakes?
dialogue.zh: 飯、牛肉，還有兩塊小蛋糕？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bean cakes are for Emma.
dialogue.zh: 那兩塊豆沙餅是給艾瑪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will ask for three.
dialogue.zh: 她一定還會再要三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben falls asleep in soup.
dialogue.zh: 小斌在火鍋旁邊睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry him, I hold his plate.
dialogue.zh: 你抱他去，我幫他拿盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same trick as last night.
dialogue.zh: 這招跟昨天晚上一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dads train twice, then.
dialogue.zh: 那爸爸們要練兩倍的力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay a bit, dinner is long.
dialogue.zh: 再坐一下，晚餐吃得久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit? Or one more tea?
dialogue.zh: 有水果嗎？還是再來一壺茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orange slices, cold, on the tray.
dialogue.zh: 柳丁切好了，冰的，在托盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit after soup is a law?
dialogue.zh: 飯後吃水果是你家的規矩？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In this house, yes, always.
dialogue.zh: 在我們家，對，永遠都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I obey, for one slice.
dialogue.zh: 那我服從，就吃一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug is slow with the sticks.
dialogue.zh: 道格用筷子還是很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him a spoon, be kind.
dialogue.zh: 給他一支湯匙吧，善良一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He refused, he is stubborn.
dialogue.zh: 他拒絕了，他就是固執。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He watched me learn, now him.
dialogue.zh: 他剛看我在學，現在輪到他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We laugh, but nobody leaves.
dialogue.zh: 我們笑著，但沒有一個人離席。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still full, not ready to move.
dialogue.zh: 還沒吃飽，還不想走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom, your cakes were the best.
dialogue.zh: 媽，妳的餅是今晚最好吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will blush, say it again.
dialogue.zh: 她會臉紅，你再造一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, a word about Monday.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，關於週一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The taxi comes at nine thirty.
dialogue.zh: 計程車九點半會到門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who takes you to the airport?
dialogue.zh: 誰送你們去機場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A car, we booked it today.
dialogue.zh: 一台車，我今天才預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me drive you, please.
dialogue.zh: 讓我親自送你們，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You already gave us three days.
dialogue.zh: 你已經整整陪了我們三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three nights, four days of noise.
dialogue.zh: 三晚，四天的吵鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our own house stays too quiet.
dialogue.zh: 我們自己家一年到頭都太安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your daughter will speak Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 妳女兒一定會說中文。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can count one to ten.
dialogue.zh: 她已經會從一數到十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea gets cold, the stove is off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ɡɛts koʊld, ðə stoʊv ɪz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 茶涼了，爐火也關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we sit and just talk.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就坐著慢慢聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table stays like this?
dialogue.zh: 桌子就這樣亂著不管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let dishes live till morning.
dialogue.zh: 碗盤留到早上再收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom says one song before bed.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽說睡覺前要唱一首歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We know one, from a card.
dialogue.zh: 我們會一首，是從卡片上學來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sing it here in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 就在廚房裡唱吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two voices, then a bow.
dialogue.zh: 兩個聲音，唱完再鞠個躬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifth meal closed, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 第五頓結束了，謝謝你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we say goodbye here.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們就在這裡說再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday sun is in the hall.
dialogue.zh: 週一的太陽照進了走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is nine twenty, almost time.
dialogue.zh: 已經九點二十，時間快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sleep your six hours?
dialogue.zh: 你有睡滿你那六小時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept, the bed did its job.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɛpt, ðə bɛd dɪd ɪts dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 我睡著了，那張床很有功勞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your room is empty already.
dialogue.zh: 你的房間已經清空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two towels folded on the chair.
dialogue.zh: 兩條毛巾摺好放在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hangers all went back.
dialogue.zh: 衣架全部歸位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check under the pillow, please.
dialogue.zh: 請檢查一下枕頭下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hair clip, is this yours?
dialogue.zh: 有一個髮夾，這是你的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that is Mom's, she lost it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðæt ɪz mɑmz, ʃi lɔst ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不是，那都是我媽媽掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breakfast is eggs, toast, one fruit.
dialogue.zh: 早餐有蛋、吐司，和一份水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, we eat that fast.
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘就好，我們吃很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben holds your bag already.
dialogue.zh: 小斌已經抱著你的袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is sad, but he is brave.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz sæd, bʌt hi ɪz breɪv./
dialogue.zh: 他難過，可是他很勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hug him, he needs one.
dialogue.zh: 抱他一下，他需要這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This hug goes to Emma too.
dialogue.zh: 這個擁抱也要替我抱抱艾瑪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take this bag for the road.
dialogue.zh: 這個袋子是給你們路上用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is inside, tell me.
dialogue.zh: 裡面是什麼，跟我說一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tea tin, two cakes, one map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ti tɪn, tu keɪks, wʌn mæp./
dialogue.zh: 一罐茶、兩塊餅、一張地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You drew this map by hand?
dialogue.zh: 這張地圖是你手畫的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I marked the night market here.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡畫了夜市的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We never went, we had soup.
dialogue.zh: 我們根本沒去，都在家裡喝湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, then. Bring Emma.
dialogue.zh: 那就下次，把艾瑪也帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is nine, she will love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz naɪn, ʃi wɪl lʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她九歲了，她一定會愛上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will ring two times again.
dialogue.zh: 那個門鈴還會再響兩次的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next summer, or this winter?
dialogue.zh: 明年夏天，還是今年冬天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter is cold, stay warm.
dialogue.zh: 冬天很冷，穿暖一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your quilt was warm enough.
dialogue.zh: 你們那條被子夠暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taxi waits at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 計程車已經等在大門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine thirty on the dot, fast.
dialogue.zh: 九點半整點到，好準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver knows this road.
dialogue.zh: 這位司機認得這條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, no traffic now.
dialogue.zh: 現在沒塞車，二十分鐘就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the big one, I take two.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə bɪɡ wʌn, aɪ teɪk tu./
dialogue.zh: 大的那箱你抬，兩個小的我拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They close with one push.
dialogue.zh: 後車門推一下就關起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doug has cash, or the app?
dialogue.zh: 道格帶有現金，還是用軟體付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He pays, he likes to pay.
dialogue.zh: 他付錢，他喜歡搶著付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom stands at the window.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽站在窗戶那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave, before she cries out.
dialogue.zh: 先揮手，趁她還沒哭出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, give her the drawing.
dialogue.zh: 小斌，把那張畫交給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He drew a boat, and four of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dru ə boʊt, ænd fɔr ʌv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 他畫了一艘船，畫裡四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will frame that one.
dialogue.zh: 這張我要裝進相框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The empty frame, finally.
dialogue.zh: 那個空相框終於有東西了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seatbelt on, windows up.
dialogue.zh: 繫好安全帶，窗戶搖上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool air, good, we can rest.
dialogue.zh: 空氣涼涼的，剛好讓我們休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved your number, text me.
dialogue.zh: 你的號碼我存好了，傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When we land, first thing.
dialogue.zh: 我們一落地，第一件就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You land near your lunch time.
dialogue.zh: 你們降落的時候差不多是午餐時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirteen hours, I will sleep.
dialogue.zh: 十三個小時，我會先睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boarding starts at twelve.
dialogue.zh: 十二點開始登機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check two bags, then sit.
dialogue.zh: 我們託運兩個行李箱，然後坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The counter closes at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 報到櫃台十一點就關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten o'clock, and we are early.
dialogue.zh: 十點到，我們還早得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emma will run to you both.
dialogue.zh: 艾瑪一定會朝你們兩個跑過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And Grandma waits with signs.
dialogue.zh: 還有舉著接機牌子的奶奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say hi to her for us.
dialogue.zh: 幫我們跟她說一聲你好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will say it in Chinese.
dialogue.zh: 我要用中文對她說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The road home feels long.
dialogue.zh: 回家的路感覺特別長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen hours, and dark there.
dialogue.zh: 差十四個小時，那頭還是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not forget the tea tin.
