dialogue.zh: 別忘了那罐茶葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cup on the plane, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就先在飛機上喝一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The house will feel big.
dialogue.zh: 這房子會突然變很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pillows, one bed, quiet.
dialogue.zh: 兩個枕頭、一張床，然後安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep your cup here.
dialogue.zh: 你的杯子我會留在我們家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how guests come back.
dialogue.zh: 聽說這樣客人才會再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben, wave, they can see you.
dialogue.zh: 小斌揮手，他們還看得到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waves with the whole arm.
dialogue.zh: 他整條手臂都在搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring me once you are seated.
dialogue.zh: 坐下來以後打個電話給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calls from there cost a lot.
dialogue.zh: 從那邊打電話回來很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then text, one word is fine.
dialogue.zh: 那就傳訊息，一個字就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Landed, safe, love you.
dialogue.zh: 「落地、平安、愛你們」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is all I need.
dialogue.zh: 有這一句我就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your door stays open, right?
dialogue.zh: 你們家的門會一直開著，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always, and the guest room too.
dialogue.zh: 一直開著，客房也一直留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two towels, I know the drill.
dialogue.zh: 兩條毛巾，我懂這個流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next year I visit you.
dialogue.zh: 明年換我去你們那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come, and bring your own quilt.
dialogue.zh: 來吧，記得帶你自己的被子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chicago has snow, I hear.
dialogue.zh: 聽說芝加哥會下雪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring one warm coat, two gloves.
dialogue.zh: 帶一件厚外套，兩副手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taxi turns the corner.
dialogue.zh: 計程車轉過那個街角了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wave until the house looks small.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi weɪv ənˈtɪl ðə haʊs lʊks smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我們揮手，直到房子看起來變得好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben asks what you said.
dialogue.zh: 小斌問我你跟他說了什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him, next year for sure.
dialogue.zh: 告訴他，明年一定再見面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The album page has one photo.
dialogue.zh: 相簿最後那一頁有照片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print two more, for Emma's room.
dialogue.zh: 再洗兩張，貼在艾瑪的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch? Amy made soup again.
dialogue.zh: 午餐嗎？艾米又煮了一鍋湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We eat the box you packed.
dialogue.zh: 我們吃你幫我們裝的餐盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is one now, you are up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌn naʊ, ju ɑr ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 現在一點，你們應該已經起飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We ate, and Doug is snoring.
dialogue.zh: 我們吃過了，道格在打呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours in, eleven to go.
dialogue.zh: 飛了兩小時，還有十一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He snores louder than the engine.
dialogue.zh: 他打呼比引擎聲音還大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea tin, did you open it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti tɪn, dɪd ju ˈoʊpən ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那罐茶葉，你們打開了沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew gave hot water, free.
dialogue.zh: 空服員給了熱水，不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the plan worked.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我的安排就成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You planned our whole stay.
dialogue.zh: 你把我們這幾天都排好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three nights, five meals, two rounds.
dialogue.zh: 三晚、五頓飯、兩輪遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one guest who can use sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn ɡɛst hu kæn juz stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 還有一位學會用筷子的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven thirty, your time there.
dialogue.zh: 十一點半，那是你們那邊的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma waits with Emma there.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶會帶著艾瑪在那邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our door stays open for you.
dialogue.zh: 我們家這扇門，永遠為你們開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two rings, then I will come.
dialogue.zh: 那就按兩次鈴，我一定再來。
